June 16, 2018 - By Hazel Jackson
Wedbush Securities Inc decreased its stake in Johnson & Johnson (JNJ) by 26.38% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Wedbush Securities Inc sold 12,007 shares as the company’s stock declined 8.03% with the market. The institutional investor held 33,501 shares of the major pharmaceuticals company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $4.29M, down from 45,508 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Wedbush Securities Inc who had been investing in Johnson & Johnson for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $328.86B market cap company. The stock increased 0.16% or $0.2 during the last trading session, reaching $122.61. About 13.17M shares traded or 95.52% up from the average. Johnson & Johnson (NYSE:JNJ) has declined 4.75% since June 16, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 17.32% the S&P500.
